message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The fact: defendant bought sodium azide (叠氮化钠) and stored it at his residence. Police seized 2 packages, 2457.904 grams. Sodium azide is a dangerous chemical, used as explosive, toxic. The charge is "非法储存危险物质罪" which translates to "illegal storage of dangerous substances" (illegal storage of dangerous chemicals). In Chinese criminal law, the relevant article is Article 138 of the Criminal Law (dangerous chemicals). The crime is "非法储存危险物质罪". So answer: [罪名]非法储存危险物质<eoa>.

Check examples: For similar case, they gave "容留他人吸毒" etc. So format: [罪名]非法储存危险物质<eoa>.

Thus final answer.
